Center is (3, k), since it lies on the perpendicular bisector of the chord from (2,0) to (4,0).

Radius squared: r² = 1 + k².

Distance from (3,k) to the line x − y = 0 is |3 − k|/√2, so tangency requires

(3 − k)²/2 = 1 + k²

9 − 6k + k² = 2 + 2k²

k² + 6k − 7 = 0

(k + 7)(k − 1) = 0, so k = 1 or k = −7.

Both give valid circles, since r² = 1 + k² > 0 in each case. The sum of the y-coordinates is 1 + (−7) = −6.

ANSWER: -6
